adjacentFacilityFamilyFor3C1f.name: Barangay halls and community complexes
adjacentFacilityFamilyFor3C1f.reason: Many day-care centers are physically inside barangay halls. Mapping halls and embedded services requires co-location-aware implementation to avoid duplicate-building clutter.
adjacentFacilityFamilyFor3C1f.rule: Reuse BetterBarangay's source-backed current barangay facility data where possible rather than inventing a second directory.

findings: The 2020 named day-care inventory reconciles exactly to the 2023 post-transfer counts: 22 current day-care centers and one current child-minding center.
All 18 day-care centers and three child-minding centers removed by the geography filter are in the transferred barangays; no unnamed replacement facility is needed to explain the 2023 totals.
The Social Development Center, Makati Youth Home, Youth Center and Senior Citizen Center each remain one-facility categories in the 2023 city statistics.
Makati Youth Home has the strongest current external operating evidence through DSWD/JJWC accreditation and operational records.
Poblacion Public Market remains the current-Makati city-owned market candidate; Cembo Talipapa is outside current Makati.
Co-located day-care, barangay-hall and social-welfare services should not automatically become duplicate building pins.
